directAnswer.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. Both printed distances are 5 m, and the material cell is sand and small stone 5–16 mm. It is not a trailer pump for a long line. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists B500S-83D at 7.5 kW, 380 V, two-stage structure pump, manual / electric, vertical 5 m, horizontal 5 m, sand and small stone 5–16 mm, 915 × 550 × 550 mm and 280 kg. The boom note says a short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 10 Series, which prints 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, horizontal 25 m, aggregate 2 cm and below, hopper 0.1 m³, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. The page does not print a vertical distance. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
